name: Two-way Pub/Sub CDC — YugabyteDB ⇄ YugabyteDB (loop prevention)
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/setup-pubsub-ybdb.sh && echo "✅ Two-way pub/sub exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-pubsub-bidir-ybdb.sh && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → bidir-demo   (guided two-way CDC demo)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → bidir-ws     (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-a       (YSQL shell → site A)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-b       (YSQL shell → site B)"'

tasks.label: bidir-demo
tasks.detail: "Both Ways at Once" — two-way CDC: loop detection via replication origins, conflict divergence, disjoint ownership (init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb && echo '⇄  bidir-demo  —  Two-way Pub/Sub CDC (YugabyteDB ⇄ YugabyteDB)' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: bidir-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual two-way CDC commands — applier.sh, ysqlsh (init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb)
tasks.command: cd init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb && echo '⇄  bidir-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual applier.sh and ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: ysql-a
tasks.detail: Open a YSQL shell on SITE A (127.0.0.1) (init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '🟢 Site A (127.0.0.1)' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.1

tasks.label: ysql-b
tasks.detail: Open a YSQL shell on SITE B (127.0.0.11) (init-pubsub-bidir-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '🔵 Site B (127.0.0.11)' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.11/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.11
